modpack.name: Truckers World ModPack
releaseNotes: We’ve released an updated version of the **Truckers World ModPack**, focused on fixing bugs, improving compatibility, and making the overall pack much more stable.

This updated ModPack includes **most of the original mods from our previous pack**, along with a number of fixes and improvements to help provide a smoother and more reliable experience in Euro Truck Simulator 2.
* Several problem mods have been corrected
* Most of the original Truckers World mods are still included
* General improvements to help reduce crashes and other issues
We’ve worked on making this version of the **Truckers World ModPack** as stable and reliable as possible while keeping the mods our community enjoys.
Thank you to everyone who has helped test the pack and reported issues. 💛
**Truckers World ModPack — Updated, Fixed & Ready to Roll!**
